trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api v2.3.1 (the latest deploy) was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. Deployment history showed v2.3.0 as the most recent release healthy in production.
2. **Rolled back**: All production regions rolled back to v2.3.0. Verified the service is now healthy in all regions with error rate down to ~0.2%.
3. **Opened incident**: SEV2 incident INC-0001 for checkout-api describing the health-check failure, the rollback to v2.3.0, and the verified recovery. The on-call engineer has been paged.

The first attempt to create the incident timed out, but a check confirmed no incident existed, so I retried safely using an idempotency key — only one incident was created.
